question: According to the World Bank classification 2020-2021, India belongs to the category of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lower-middle income country**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the World Bank's classification of economies by income level in **2020-2021**, India is classified as a **lower-middle-income country.**
 
• This means that India's GNI per capita (gross national income per capita) is betwee**n $1,136 and $4,465**.
 
• In 2020, India's GNI per capita was** $1,970,** so it falls within the lower-middle-income category.
 
• The World Bank uses GNI per capita to classify countries because it is a good measure of a country's overall economic well-being.
 
• GNI per capita takes into account a country's total output of goods and services, as well as its population size.
 
• There are four income categories used by the World Bank:
 
 
• **Low-income countries**: GNI per capita of $1,135 or less
 
• **Lower-middle-income countries**: GNI per capita between $1,136 and $4,465
 
• **Upper-middle-income countries**: GNI per capita between $4,466 and $13,845
 
• **High-income countries**: GNI per capita of $13,845 or more.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Bank**

 
 
• World Bank was created in July 1944.
 
• The Headquarters of the World Bank is in Washington, D.C., United States.
 
• The World Bank is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• It comprises two institutions: the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), and the International Development Association (IDA).​
